sample_unit: participants (34 professional interviews, 7 innovator staff interviews, 14 PPIE focus group participants)
models_evaluated: AI tool for detecting potential lung cancer abnormalities on radiology imaging (unnamed)

links.outcome: Implementation challenges reported by innovators and professionals regarding governance of AI in the NHS
links.effect: Innovators and healthcare professionals reported fragmented legal and regulatory frameworks and unclear governance within the NHS as key implementation challenges.
links.quote: Innovators as well healthcare professionals highlighted a number of implementation challenges, particularly around fragmented legal and regulatory frameworks and unclear governance within the NHS.

screen.reason: Qualitative implementation study using interviews and focus groups to explore the experiences and perceptions of clinicians, innovators, and patient groups regarding the deployment of an AI tool for lung cancer detection in NHS radiology departments.
